title: Site Rent and Lease Term Schedule by Lot Class — Home-Site Lease
content:
**Home-Site Lease — monthly site rent and available terms**

The base monthly site rent is the standard monthly rent for a new move-in on a twelve-month term at the lot class. A month-to-month term carries a monthly premium added to the twelve-month rent; a twenty-four-month term carries a monthly reduction from the twelve-month rent. The move-in concession is a percentage of the first full month's site rent on a new twelve- or twenty-four-month lease; 0.0 percent means no concession.

| Lot class | Base monthly site rent (USD) | Month-to-month available | Month-to-month premium (USD per month) | Twelve-month term available | Twenty-four-month term available | Twenty-four-month reduction (USD per month) | Move-in concession, first full month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 587.00 | yes | 40.00 | yes | no | not applicable | 50.0 percent |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 621.00 | yes | 40.00 | yes | no | not applicable | 50.0 percent |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 668.00 | yes | 45.00 | yes | yes | 12.00 | 25.0 percent |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 709.00 | yes | 45.00 | yes | yes | 14.00 | 25.0 percent |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 752.00 | no | not applicable | yes | yes | 16.00 | 0.0 percent |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 839.00 | no | not applicable | yes | yes | 19.00 | 0.0 percent |

"Not applicable" marks a premium or reduction for a term the lot class does not offer.

### Points read from the schedule

- Every lot class offers the twelve-month term.
- The month-to-month term exists only on the four Standard and Preferred lot classes; the Greenbelt and Lakefront lot classes cannot hold or choose it.
- The twenty-four-month term exists only on the four multi-section lot classes (Standard, Preferred, Greenbelt and Lakefront Multi-Section); the single-section lot classes do not offer it.
- The Greenbelt and Lakefront lot classes carry no move-in concession.

### Hypothetical illustration

On a Preferred Multi-Section Home Site the schedule gives a base rent of 709.00, a month-to-month premium of 45.00 a month and a twenty-four-month reduction of 14.00 a month; a concession of 25.0 percent of a first full month's rent of 709.00 is 177.25.
